q: After they will announce the results, we (plan) a celebration.
Fill in the gap: When your plane _____, please call me.
He ___ ill since last Monday.
e:
'Since' সময়ের শুরু নির্দেশ করে এবং ঘটনাটি এখনও চলছে। এমন ক্ষেত্রে Present Perfect Tense (has/have + Past Participle) ব্যবহৃত হয়। এখানে be-ক্রিয়ার রূপ has been।
মনে রাখুন:
since Monday, since 2010, since morning – Present Perfect
I have known him since 2015.

q: He ___ the office just now.
I _________ in this house for 40 years.
Fill in the blank: He said that the earth —— round.
e:
Reported speech-এ মূল বাক্য অতীত হলেও চিরন্তন সত্য বা সর্বজনীন তথ্য বদলায় না, সেটি Present Indefinite-এই থাকে। পৃথিবী গোল, এটি চিরসত্য, তাই 'is'।
মনে রাখুন:
Universal truth: reporting verb অতীত হলেও tense পরিবর্তন হয় না
উদাহরণ: The teacher said that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

q: Which sentence is the correct one?
o: I wish I was a rich man.
It was twelve years since he left the country.
I fancy I were a magician.
It is high time we will take stern steps against corruption.

q: Fill in the blank: We shall ____ the work before he comes.
Choose the sentence in the Future Continuous Tense.
o: I will not give you a pen.
He has read various kinds of books.
She will have cooked dinner by six o'clock.
They will be hosting the event next Saturday.

q: Choose the correct sentence:
o: I will go there after I have got proper information.
I will go there after I get proper information.
I will go there after I had got proper information.
I will go there after I will get proper information.

q: It has been so long since I last ________ him.
She ___ in the library for two hours.
I had been watching the Game of Thrones when my friend called.
After they had already eaten, the guests (arrive) at the party.
She waved at me as I _______ the street.
When I saw the vase in the shop window, I knew it was exactly what I ___
e: Knew অতীত, তাই সেই সময়ে যা খোঁজা চলছিল তা বোঝাতে Past Continuous was looking for বসে। অর্থ: দোকানের জানালায় ফুলদানিটা দেখে বুঝলাম এটাই আমি ঠিক খুঁজছিলাম। Look for বর্তমান, looked for সম্পূর্ণ কাজ বোঝায়, আর had been looking for আরও আগে থেকে খুঁজে চলা বোঝায়, যা এখানে অপ্রয়োজনীয়। Look for-এর শেষ preposition for বাদ দেওয়া যায় না।

q: I thought that I see her before. Choose the correct tense of the underlined verb.
Which of the following sentences is correct?
o: The patient had died before the doctor has arrived.
The patient had died before the doctor arrived.
The patient died before the doctor arrives.
The patient had died before the doctor had arrived.
e: দুটি অতীত ঘটনার মধ্যে যেটি আগে ঘটেছে সেটি Past Perfect-এ এবং যেটি পরে ঘটেছে সেটি Past Indefinite-এ বসে। ডাক্তার আসার আগেই রোগী মারা গেছে, তাই before-এর আগে had died এবং পরে arrived হবে। অন্য বাক্যে tense মেলেনি: arrives ও has arrived অতীতের প্রসঙ্গে বেমানান, আর দুই অংশেই had থাকলে আগে-পরের পার্থক্য ঝাপসা হয়। উদাহরণ: The match had started before we reached the ground.

q: By next year, she ______________ from university. Fill in the gap with the right tense.
